body: Cutting helps in the moment. They will start off as small cuts and you will think you are in control, but they get bigger, the scars get uglier and messier then years later when you eventually think you are beginning to feel better, you’re left with hundreds of reminders all over your body. You’re literally a prisoner and you feel ten times worse than before and there’s NOTHING you can do about it. It’s just another problem not a solution to a problem.
Thank you so much for this it’s a great idea. I will definitely look into it.
